FX-MIX-001.says: Invert, channel rgb, amount 100, at mix 50: every sample of the drawing half way between its own value and its negative's, in linear light, so black and white both land on the same light grey, 0.5 in linear light, #bcbcbc but for rounding (187.5), and the skin #f6d6be on #b59f91; each pixel's covering is kept. It is not Invert at amount 50, FX-INVERT-003, which meets in the encoded middle, #808080.

FX-MIX-002.says: The same Invert with no mix written, as every file before D-202: read as 100, so the frame is FX-INVERT-001 exactly.

FX-MIX-003.says: Mix 100 written: the same as no mix, FX-MIX-002.

FX-MIX-004.says: Mix 0: the drawing, exactly, as if the Invert were switched off.

FX-MIX-005.says: Mix 25: a quarter of the way from the drawing to its negative.

FX-MIX-006.says: Gaussian Blur, sigma 1, edges transparent, at mix 50: the layer grows by 3 pixels on each side, and the sharp drawing is laid back in where it was, not at the grown layer's corner: each pixel half the blurred drawing and half the sharp one, so the empty rows and column round the drawing take half the blur's spill.

FX-MIX-007.says: Mix keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 FX-MIX-001 and frame 4 FX-MIX-002.

FX-MIX-008.says: Mix eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-MIX-002, as is frame 4; frame 0 is the drawing.

FX-MIX-009.says: Invert at mix 50, then Exposure -1 at no mix: the Exposure takes the mixed picture, so the frame is FX-MIX-001 at half its light.

FX-MIX-010.says: Exposure -1, then Exposure +1 at mix 50: the second is mixed with what it was given, the darkened drawing, not with the drawing, so each colour is three quarters of the drawing's, not all of it.

FX-MIX-011.says: Invert at mix 50, switched off: the drawing.

FX-MIX-012.says: Invert at mix 50 on an adjustment layer above the drawing: the frame beneath is the drawing alone, so this is FX-MIX-001.

FX-MIX-013.says: Light Wrap, as it starts, at mix 50, on Light Wrap's box over its bright bands: the box takes half the light FX-WRAP-001 lays on it, and the bands round it are untouched.

FX-MIX-014.says: Invert at mix 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIX-015.says: Invert at mix -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIX-016.says: Invert with its mix keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIX-017.says: Posterize Time, 12 a second, at mix 50: it holds the layer in time and has no picture to mix, so its mix must be 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
